$comment: Golden set seeded from the maintainer's real queries (2026-09-06). Ground truth marked `confirmed: false` still needs a human decision — see docs/TODO.md. Half of these cases are NEGATIVE: they must produce no_local_result rather than an answer assembled from irrelevant top-k (the spec §1, failure mode 1).

cases.query:
意靜不隨流水轉
心閒遠與雲俱
cases.note: Reads as a 對聯, not a Tang/Song poem. Line 2 is 6 chars against line 1's 7 — likely a dropped character. If it is out of corpus this is a correct negative.

cases.query:
靜觀世事
笑看人生
cases.note: Four-character couplet, modern calligraphic idiom. Not classical verse.

cases.query:
話涕霑巾
諫丹墀有故人向來論社稷爲
猶戀主久客羨歸秦黃閣長司
羣盜至今在先朝赤子存君王

expect.text: 羣盜至今在，先朝赤子存。君王猶戀主，久客羨歸秦。黃閣長司諫，丹墀有故人。向來論社稷，爲話涕霑巾。
expect.author: 杜甫

cases.note: Recovered by reading lines bottom-to-top and re-segmenting at 5-char boundaries; the pasted line breaks fall mid-line. 40 chars, scans as a 五律.

cases.query:
雲井涼煙如殘
空山一葉依心驚
cases.note: 6 + 7 characters. Neither line scans; could be column-interleaved or a lossy transcription. Left unlabelled deliberately — the index should tell us.

cases.query:
白頭不老
希施持戒
cases.note: Buddhist vocabulary (持戒). Almost certainly outside 全唐詩/宋詞.

cases.query:
水
秋
無
淨
泥
春
花
開
落
自
cases.note: 10 characters, one per line — a vertical column transcribed line-by-line. Reversed it reads 自落開花春／泥淨無秋水, which has the shape of a 迴文 couplet. Must be joined into a single stream before any matching runs.

cases.query:
在歲月中堅持
在前行中努力
生活就是甜的
人生就是美的
cases.note: NEGATIVE CASE, load-bearing. Modern vernacular Chinese (就是, 的). Vector search will happily return 6-char Tang lines for this. It must not produce an answer.

cases.query:
境
塵
之
超
地
六
cases.note: 6 characters, one per line. Reversed: 六地超之塵境. 六塵 is Buddhist terminology, so likely out of corpus.

cases.query:
地何病著名涌平夜岸細
一所休官章江野舟危草
沙似老應文大闊星檣微
鷗天飄飄豈流月垂獨風

expect.title: 旅夜書懷
expect.author: 杜甫
expect.text: 細草微風岸，危檣獨夜舟。星垂平野闊，月涌大江流。名豈文章著，官應老病休。飄飄何所似，天地一沙鷗。

cases.note: THE case that breaks §7.3 as written. A 4x10 grid written in vertical columns read right-to-left, pasted row-wise. Transposing right-to-left lands 34 of 40 characters correctly, giving a 16-character exact prefix (細草微風岸危檣獨夜舟星垂平野闊月, in match form) and an 8-character exact tail. The 6 displaced characters are three transposition pairs, one of which crosses a column boundary — so edit tolerance is needed on top of the transpose, but the exact runs are already far above the 5-character short-circuit threshold of §7.1. Line reversal alone recovers nothing here. Verified in packages/retrieval/src/reorder.test.ts.

cases.query:
辛亥月
鶴舞飛翔
己亥年
cases.note: NEGATIVE CASE. A calligraphy signature block: 干支 cyclical date plus a title. Not verse at all. 辛亥月 is also malformed as a date — 干支 months are rare and this pairs a stem-branch month with a different stem-branch year.
NEGATIVE CASE. Four-character calligraphy title in isolation. Below the 5-character short-circuit threshold of §7.1, so it must not short-circuit.

cases.query:
客
莫
基
東
幹
觀
歎
執
軍

木
cases.note: 12 characters, one per line. 12 factors as 3x4 or 4x3, so the original grid width is ambiguous — the reorder search must try both rather than assume.
